description: This file defines an asynchronous TypeScript function 'importFreshModule' that dynamically imports a module from a specified URL, intended for use in testing environments that emulate code-split chunks by relying on URL hash behavior.

methods.name: export async function importFreshModule<TModule>( importFreshModule
methods.description: Asynchronously imports a module from a constructed URL based on provided 'from' and 'specifier' parameters, and returns it cast to a generic type TModule.
